facts: Joel Kaso is a web designer from Albania. He designs, codes and sets up every site himself, so the client talks to one person. He works with clients in Albania, the UK, the EU and the USA, fully online.

He builds custom websites for hotels, guesthouses, restaurants, cafés, bars, salons, clinics, trades and other local businesses. No templates and no page builders: each site is hand-built, light and fast on phones, and tested with Google PageSpeed before it goes live.

Prices (fixed packages): Essential Landing starts at 150–200€; Business Pro, the most popular, starts at 300–450€; Custom Signature starts at 600€ and up. Payment is a 50% deposit to start and 50% upon launch. Domain registration (about 15€ a year) is billed separately and stays in the client's name. No required monthly fees to Joel.

Packages: (1) Essential Landing, from 150–200€: a single high-converting page with up to 5 sections, one language (Albanian or English), a direct WhatsApp button and Google Maps, delivered in 3–4 days, 2 rounds of revisions. Example: Vjosa Rafting. (2) Business Pro, from 300–450€, the most popular: a multi-section or multi-page site (up to 5 pages), bilingual with an EN/SQ switch, a custom enquiry or booking form plus WhatsApp, delivered in 5–7 days, 2 rounds of revisions. Example: Lule Balkan Kitchen. (3) Custom Signature, from 600€: a fully bespoke layout with interactive scroll film and hero choreography, bilingual EN/SQ localisation, automated lead routing (webhooks, n8n or a CRM), delivered in 10–14 days, 3 rounds of revisions. Example: Hotel Kaso Ervehe.

Features a client can pick in the quick quote: direct booking system, WhatsApp ordering, English and Albanian, a menu or price list they edit, Google Business Profile and local SEO, a photo gallery with lightbox, gift vouchers. The quote shows the package they land on and its starting price: Essential Landing from 150€ for trades and other businesses, Business Pro from 300€ for restaurants and salons (picking booking, two languages, an editable menu or the Google profile moves an Essential Landing up to Business Pro), Custom Signature from 600€ for hotels and guesthouses.

Timing depends on the package: Essential Landing 3–4 days, Business Pro 5–7 days, Custom Signature 10–14 days. Step 1: a 20-minute call or WhatsApp chat about the business and its goals. Step 2: within 48 hours, a free preview of the homepage on the client's own phone, before paying anything. Step 3: after the 50% deposit, the full build and polish, tested on every screen. Step 4: launch day, live on the client's own domain with Google listing and a short video guide; the other 50% is paid at launch.

Payment: a 50% deposit to start and 50% upon launch. Before any payment the client gets a free homepage preview, and they check the finished site on a private link before the second payment. Domain registration (about 15€ a year) is billed separately under the client's ownership. No required monthly fees to Joel.

Direct bookings come in with 0% commission, through instant WhatsApp requests or a built-in booking calendar (business and premium sites). The site can also connect the tools the business already uses (OpenTable, Fresha, Booksy, Mindbody, Square, Airbnb or Booking.com). Orders and pre-orders can go to WhatsApp.

Free call: book one with the 'Book a free call' WhatsApp button; Joel fits the time to your time zone. Proof: his family's Hotel Kaso Ervehe is on Booking.com (https://www.booking.com/hotel/al/kaso-ervehe.html), rated 9.0.

Ongoing costs: no monthly lock-in. The only required ongoing cost is the domain name, about 10–15€ a year. Optional care plan: 25€ a month, Joel makes text, price and photo changes (usually within two days) and checks the site, booking and Google listing every month; it can be stopped any time and the site stays the client's. Template platforms and agencies often cost 30–100€ a month in plugins, hosting and maintenance.
Ownership: the client owns everything. The domain is registered in the client's name and the code is handed over, so they can move it or change designer whenever they like.
Editing: at launch Joel sends a short video showing how to change text, prices and photos in minutes, with no technical skills.

Bookings and orders reach the owner however is easiest: straight to their WhatsApp with the customer's details filled in, to Telegram, to email, or into a booking calendar. Direct bookings pay 0% commission, unlike booking platforms that take up to about 18%.
Security: no database and no plugins, so there is far less to attack and nothing to keep updating.
Languages: sites can be in English and Albanian. Joel replies within a day, in English or Albanian.

Case study: Hotel Kaso Ervehe in Përmet, Albania, Joel's family hotel and his first real client project. Up to 18% of every stay went to booking platforms. He built a fast site of its own in English and Albanian, a direct booking calendar, booking alerts on Telegram and the route on Google Maps.

Portfolio: the work grid shows eight sites. The real client site is Hotel Kaso Ervehe, Joel's family hotel in Përmet (its new site launches soon). Brolin Tattoo is a live project on Netlify. The demo sites (concept builds with made-up business names) are Ura Coffee Roasters (coffee roastery, Glasgow), Baltë Studio (pottery studio, Tirana), Lule Balkan Kitchen (restaurant, London), Northline Barbers (Manchester), Vjosa Rafting and Bojë Tattoo (fine-line and blackwork tattoo studio, Blloku, Tirana). Package examples: Essential Landing = Vjosa Rafting, Business Pro = Lule Balkan Kitchen, Custom Signature = Hotel Kaso Ervehe. Several have a full-screen scroll film in the hero.
Availability: Joel is taking new projects.

Free preview: a business owner can send Joel their business name and a few photos on WhatsApp, and within 48 hours he shows them their own homepage on their phone, free. They pay nothing unless they want the full site; if they do, a 50% deposit starts the build and the other 50% is due at launch.
Contact: WhatsApp +355 68 572 7406, or the contact form at the bottom of the page. The Quick quote section on the page gives a price and timing in three steps and sends the brief to Joel on WhatsApp.
